profile.summary: A small educational consulting company in Northern California. It provides independent educational evaluations and private or overflow assessments for students with special needs, helps families and schools prepare for IEP (Individualized Education Program) meetings, and supports nonpublic school and residential placements. It serves Sacramento, El Dorado and Placer counties.
